title: Delta Electronics InfraSuite Device Master ExeCommandInCommandLineMode Exposed Dangerous Function Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Delta Electronics InfraSuite Device Master. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the ExeCommandInCommandLineMode function. The issue results from an exposed dangerous function. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of an administrator.
